summary: Editing purchase order emails before sending them to a supplier in Business Central, through a new Send by Email button in the Print/Send menu of purchase documents. It was built by a community member through the code development initiative and is tied to the 2025 release wave 1.
overview:
This short "What's Cooking in Business Central" video, published 2025-03-06, shows how purchase document emails can now be edited before they go to a supplier. Purchase orders get a Send by Email button under Print/Send, like the one already in sales documents.

Clicking the button opens the familiar email editor. There the user can change the email content and add attachments. The video says the addition was built by a community member through the code development initiative and can release with 2025 wave 1.
key_points: Purchase documents get a new Send by Email button in the Print/Send menu.
The button matches what already exists in sales documents.
It opens the email editor, where the email can be edited and attachments added.
The feature was demoed in the video.
It was built by a community member through the code development initiative.
The video says it can release with 2025 wave 1.
